verdict.rationale: Zapier MCP lets a user create an MCP server whose tools are their connected app actions (9,000+ apps, 40,000+ actions). Any MCP client can connect to that server with a connection token and call those actions, with modes, tool bundles and access controls documented. missing for 10: explicit evidence that a user's own multi-step Zap workflows (not just individual app actions) can be exposed as MCP tools, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call

citations.quote: Connect any MCP client to Zapier MCP by creating a server and generating a connection token, then adding it as a Bearer header or query parameter.
It lets your AI take real actions across 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions, such as sending messages, creating tasks, and updating records
A tool bundle is a shareable link to the list of tools on your MCP server.
Zapier brings in your existing app connections automatically.
